entry.title: New: Bill 139 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 4, ARTICLE 1, SECTION 4-1-1; ARTICLE 2, SECTION 4-2-4; AND ARTICLE 4, SECTIONS 4-4-31, 4-4-34, AND 4-4-35, OF THE HAWAI‘I COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO THE ANIMAL CONTROL AND PROTECTION AGENCY

Adds definitions for “Livestock” and “Police officer”; repeals definitions for “County animal control service” and “Enforcement officer”; amends definitions for “Animal control officer”, “Animals”, and “Poultry”

Latest action: Council: Bill 139, Draft 2, passes second & final reading - 04/17/24
